newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was slow late Friday. Slaughter steers and heifers closed steady.

Inquiry was moderate, demand rather was light. Sales confirmed on 1,200 slaughter steers and 1,000 slaughter heifers late Friday and over the weekend. This week's confirmed sales 62,700 head including 17,500 head or about 28 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Heifers - select and choice 2-3 1025-1130 lbs 63.00, pen select with end choice 1130 lbs 62.00.
